entry.title: Brookfield Planning board: Housing development (2026-10-26)
entry.summary: .... Pursuant to RSA 674:43, a site plan review is the process of approving or disapproving a plan for development or change of use or expansion of use of tracts of land for non- residential uses or for [multi-family dwelling] units.
